items.title: SASSO, VIA Riyadh
items.note: Doha's award-winning Italian spot just opened its first Saudi branch, with tagliatelle tossed inside a Parmesan wheel.
items.read: KSA Edit reports that SASSO, the Italian restaurant known in Doha for its Parmesan-wheel tagliatelle and Wagyu lasagna, has opened its first Saudi branch at VIA Riyadh in Al Hada. Its Al Hazm branch in Doha won Favourite Italian Fine Dining at the FACT Dining Awards Doha 2022. The Riyadh menu includes Pasta Al Forno, a Wagyu Pinwheel Lasagna, spicy rigatoni with burrata, a wood-fired black truffle pizza and a veal risotto topped with six-hour slow-cooked veal. Prices and online booking haven't been published yet, so tables are booked by contacting the restaurant directly, and booking ahead is advised at weekends.
facts: VIA Riyadh, Makkah Al Mukarramah Rd, Al Hada

article.html:
SASSO, the Doha Italian restaurant known for its Parmesan-wheel tagliatelle and Wagyu lasagna, has opened its first Saudi branch at VIA Riyadh, open daily from 5pm to 1am.

SASSO, the Italian restaurant that made its name in Doha, has opened at VIA Riyadh. It is the brand's first branch in Saudi Arabia, and it arrives in the middle of Riyadh Season, when VIA Riyadh is one of the busiest dining addresses in the city.

The restaurant comes with a strong reputation at home. Its Al Hazm branch in Doha won Favourite Italian Fine Dining at the FACT Dining Awards Doha 2022, and the brand also runs restaurants at West Walk and Place Vendôme in the Qatari capital. When the move to Riyadh was announced in October, no opening date was given; the restaurant is now taking guests.

The Riyadh menu leans on the dishes SASSO is known for. There is Pasta Al Forno, baked fusilli with organic chicken, mushrooms and Parmesan in a creamy pink sauce, and a Wagyu Pinwheel Lasagna, rolled pasta filled with Wagyu bolognese and beef bacon. The table-side dish is the tagliatelle, tossed inside a large aged Parmesan wheel in front of you. Other plates include spicy rigatoni with burrata, a wood-fired black truffle pizza, chicken Milanese and a veal risotto topped with veal that is slow-cooked for six hours.

SASSO joins a strip of well-known international names at VIA Riyadh, the open-air dining and shopping district on Makkah Al Mukarramah Road in Al Hada, which is also home to The St. Regis Riyadh. Gymkhana, Madeo and Berenjak already serve there, and the Qatari café NOIR opened its second Riyadh branch in the same district last month. Riyadh Season began on 21 October and runs for about ten weeks, so the evenings around VIA Riyadh are at their fullest right now.

SASSO opens every day from 5pm to 1am. Booking ahead is advised, especially at the weekend, and the dress code is smart casual or business casual. Prices have not been published yet, and no online booking page has been announced, so for now a table is booked by contacting the restaurant directly.

items.title: Shayan, Al Malqa
items.note: New Indian spot with a modern twist: pastry-crusted lamb biryani, mustard prawns and rose falooda.
items.read: This is Riyadh introduced Shayan on 9 November as a new restaurant in Al Malqa serving Indian favourites with a contemporary twist, from rich curries and tandoori dishes to creative starters and desserts. Recommended dishes include a Lamb Curry Biryani baked under a golden sesame pastry crust, Sarson Jhinga char-grilled tiger prawns with yellow mustard, and a Rose Falooda with a kulfi ring, rose milk and basil seeds. The review praises the colourful interior, relaxed atmosphere and generous portions, and suggests ordering several dishes to share.
facts: Anas Bin Malik Rd, Al Malqa
items.mapQuery: Shayan, Anas Bin Malik Rd, Al Malqa

article.html:
Indian food lovers, this one is for you! There’s a new spot for Indian food in Riyadh. Meet Shayan, a restaurant in Al Malqa serving Indian favourites with a contemporary twist. From rich curries and tandoori dishes to creative starters and desserts, there’s plenty to try, especially if you’re going with a group and love sharing a little bit of everything.

The menu brings together traditional Indian flavours and modern creations, with plenty of spices and dishes fresh from the tandoor oven. You must start with the Ruby Quinoa Salad, Black Lentils or Chaat Royale, then get ready for the mains!

Here are a few dishes worth ordering. The Lamb Curry Biryani is a must, with slow-cooked lamb and saffron basmati rice tucked under a golden sesame pastry crust, topped with toasted cashews and herbs. If you prefer seafood, try the Sarson Jhinga, featuring char-grilled tiger prawns with yellow mustard, spices, and pickled pearl onions. Save some room for dessert because the Rose Falooda is worth trying, too! It comes with a creamy kulfi ring, rose milk, basil seeds, vermicelli, fresh berries, and toasted nuts.

And it’s not just about the food. Shayan has a beautiful interior, colourful decor and a relaxed atmosphere that makes it a lovely spot for dinner with friends or a family outing. The portions are generous, too, so it’s a good idea to order a few dishes and share!

Here’s where to find it:

  • Location: Al Malqa, Anas Bin Malik Road
  • Opening Hours: Daily, 1 PM – 12:30 AM
  • Reservations: 966567841382

items.title: Le Café NAC pop-up, Diriyah
items.note: London's Belgravia brasserie is doing an outdoor winter residency at Aseel Resort, nightly 6pm to midnight.
items.read: What's On Saudi Arabia reports that Le Café NAC, the French-inspired brasserie on Motcomb Street in London's Belgravia, opened a winter residency at Aseel Resort in Diriyah on Thursday 5 November. The outdoor space has bistro-style chairs, greenery, warm lighting and circular overhead structures. In London the café is known for breakfast burritos, ricotta pancakes, black truffle rigatoni and crushed milk chocolate cookies with soft serve, though the full Diriyah menu hadn't been revealed when the story ran. NAC already has a restaurant at Laysen Valley in Riyadh, and reservations carry a SAR 50 per person booking fee.

article.html:
The London brasserie will be bringing its café favourites to a gorgeous outdoor setting at Aseel Resort

Riyadh’s outdoor dining season is back, folks. And if you’re already making dinner plans for the cooler months, here’s another spot to add to the list.

Straight from London’s fashionable Belgravia neighbourhood, Le Café NAC opens in Diriyah for a winter residency at Aseel Resort on Thursday November 5. Expect pretty outdoor seating, cosy lighting and plenty of good food, all in a setting made for Riyadh’s cooler evenings.

For those unfamiliar with Le Café NAC, the London restaurant sits on Motcomb Street in Belgravia and has become a popular spot for everything from leisurely breakfasts to casual lunches, dinner dates and coffee catch-ups.

The French-inspired brasserie is known for its stylish interiors, marble-topped tables and a menu featuring comfort food with a contemporary touch. Among the dishes you’ll find at the London outpost are breakfast burritos, tuna melts, ricotta pancakes, burgers and black truffle rigatoni.

And then there’s dessert. One of its best-known creations is the crushed milk chocolate cookies served with soft serve and crispy cereal. Divine.

What to expect at Le Café NAC in Diriyah 

Based on the images, the outdoor dining space features bistro-style chairs, intimate tables, greenery and warm lighting, with circular overhead structures adding a contemporary touch. Perfect for an evening out with friends or a dinner date.

Riyadh diners may already be familiar with NAC, which has an established restaurant at Laysen Valley. The brand has also previously hosted a seasonal Winter Garden experience at Aseel Resort.

This latest residency puts the spotlight on Le Café NAC’s London identity, with its relaxed brasserie atmosphere and café-style dining. While the full menu for the Diriyah pop-up has yet to be revealed, we’re hoping some of those London favourites, particularly the cookies, make an appearance.

The good news? You can already start making reservations, with a SAR50 booking fee per person.

What: Le Café NAC

When: From Nov 5 | Daily 6pm to midnight

Where: Aseel Resort, Wadi Hanifah, Diriyah 13713

items.note: Riyadh Season's garden-themed family zone returns in a new home in Hittin, opening 18 Nov.

It is laid out as five areas: the Street Garden with giant screens, food trucks and shops; the Flower Garden with rides and skill games; the atmospheric Mystery Forest; the evening Night Garden; and Strange Creatures in the Imagination Factory, where children build a creature of their own. article.html:
The Riyadh Season family zone returns in Hittin with five themed areas, from a Flower Garden of rides to a Night Garden for evenings.

Wonder Garden, the garden-themed family zone of Riyadh Season, is coming back this year in a new home. It moves to Boulevard City in Hittin and opens on Wednesday 18 November, according to the season's published zone dates.

The zone is laid out as five areas, each with its own mood. Visitors start in the Street Garden, a welcome strip of giant screens, roaming shows, food trucks, restaurants and shops. From there, the Flower Garden is the busiest part, with rides and skill games set among floral displays, plus more places to eat and shop.

The Mystery Forest swaps rides for atmosphere: themed displays, visual effects and roaming performers. The Night Garden is built for the evening, when the focus turns to music, food and family time. The fifth area, Strange Creatures in the Imagination Factory, is the most hands-on: children restart the factory's machines and collect parts to build a creature of their own.

The move puts Wonder Garden inside one of the season's main hubs. Boulevard City, which stays open all year, started its Riyadh Season programme on 22 October, with its stage first and its attractions from 24 October. Boulevard World, also in Hittin, opened on 25 October, so families will be able to plan an evening across the area once Wonder Garden opens. Riyadh Season 2026 began on 21 October and runs across 12 zones; Suwaidi Park opens on the same day as Wonder Garden, and Al Hisn Maze follows on 19 November.

Ticket prices, opening hours and the date the zone closes for the season have not been announced yet. Riyadh Season publishes tickets and zone details on its official website, riyadhseason.com, so check there before you go, especially for the opening weekend. Plan on arriving in the early evening if you want to see the Flower Garden in daylight and stay on for the Night Garden.

ينطلق موسم سباقات الرياض 2026-2027 يوم الجمعة 16 أكتوبر 2026 في ميدان الملك عبدالعزيز للفروسية ويستمر حتى 17 أبريل 2027: 50 يوم سباق، كل جمعة وسبت، بجوائز إجمالية تبلغ 236.3 مليون ريال على مدى الموسم. والحدث الأبرز هو كأس السعودية يومي 5 و6 فبراير 2027. التذاكر وتفاصيل أيام السباق على صفحة موسم سباقات الرياض في webook.com.

تبدأ السباقات يوم الجمعة 16 أكتوبر 2026 وتختتم في 17 أبريل 2027، وكلها في ميدان الملك عبدالعزيز للفروسية في الرياض. ويحدد البرنامج الذي أعلنه نادي سباقات الخيل 50 يوم سباق على مدى ستة أشهر، أيام الجمعة والسبت، منها 21 يوما للسباقات الرئيسية و69 شوطا ضمن الكؤوس الكبرى.

أما الجوائز فتبلغ قيمتها الإجمالية 236.3 مليون ريال على مدى الموسم، منها 197.8 مليون ريال للكؤوس الكبرى. البرنامج الكامل في الإعلان الرسمي لنادي سباقات الخيل.

ما أبرز أيام السباق هذا الموسم؟

ثمانية مواعيد تحمل ثقل الموسم، وكلها تقع يوم جمعة أو سبت أو الاثنين معا.

  1. افتتاح الموسم، 16-17 أكتوبر 2026. أولى أمسيات الموسم الجديد وأول نظرة على خيل الشتاء.
  2. كأس ولي العهد، 27 نوفمبر 2026. أحد أعرق السباقات في المملكة، وقد ارتفعت جائزته هذا الموسم إلى 1.5 مليون ريال.
  3. أسبوع الملوك، 18-19 ديسمبر 2026. يومان من السباقات الرئيسية في منتصف ديسمبر.
  4. كأس خادم الحرمين الشريفين، 8-9 يناير 2027. ارتفعت جائزة الكأس إلى 2 مليون ريال.
  5. مهرجان الأمير سلطان بن عبدالعزيز الدولي، 15-16 يناير 2027. مهرجان دولي على يومين قبل كأس السعودية بثلاثة أسابيع.
  6. كأس السعودية، 5-6 فبراير 2027. النسخة الثامنة، وعطلة نهاية الأسبوع التي يخطط لها معظم الزوار رحلتهم.
  7. كؤوس الملك عبدالعزيز (المؤسس)، 12 مارس 2027. أمسية واحدة بجوائز تبلغ 10.9 مليون ريال.
  8. ختام الموسم، 17 أبريل 2027. آخر يوم سباق قبل استراحة الصيف.

ماذا يحدث في عطلة كأس السعودية؟

يقام كأس السعودية على مدى يومين، الجمعة 5 والسبت 6 فبراير 2027، في ميدان الملك عبدالعزيز للفروسية. وهي النسخة الثامنة من الحدث الذي يبني البرنامج كله نحوه.

التغيير الأهم لمتابعي التصنيفات هذا العام: ديربي السعودية ارتقى من المجموعة الثالثة إلى المجموعة الثانية بقرار من لجنة التصنيف الآسيوية، ويقام في يوم كأس السعودية نفسه. وتقام الجولة الأخيرة من سلسلة سيف الرياض الجديدة في العطلة ذاتها. إن كانت سباقات الخيل السعودية على قائمتك أصلا، فهذه هي العطلة التي تستحق الوجود في الرياض، وهي التي تخطط لها مبكرا.

ما الجديد في موسم 2026-2027؟

ثلاثة تغييرات تلفت النظر في برنامج نادي سباقات الخيل.

  1. ديربي السعودية يصعد إلى المجموعة الثانية اعتبارا من هذا الموسم، ويحتفظ بموقعه في يوم كأس السعودية، 6 فبراير 2027.
  2. سلسلة تاج الرياض تنطلق لأول مرة: سلسلة جديدة من ثلاث جولات للأمهار المنتجة محليا، تقام في 4 ديسمبر و22 يناير و12 مارس، بجوائز تبلغ 6 ملايين ريال على الجولات الثلاث.
  3. سلسلة سيف الرياض تقام بالتوازي للمهرات، بجولات في 5 ديسمبر و8 يناير و6 فبراير.

وترتفع الجوائز في الكؤوس العريقة أيضا، ومنها كأس خادم الحرمين الشريفين إلى 2 مليون ريال وكأس ولي العهد إلى 1.5 مليون ريال.

كيف تسير عطلات السباق في ميدان الملك عبدالعزيز للفروسية؟

تقع أيام السباق في الجمعة والسبت، أي عطلة نهاية الأسبوع في السعودية: لا حاجة إلى إجازة ولا إلى حسابات ليلة الدوام. وستة أشهر بواقع 50 يوم سباق تعني أنك نادرا ما تضطر إلى فرض موعد بعينه، فإن فاتتك عطلة فالتي تليها فيها سباق على الأرجح.

ينشر نادي سباقات الخيل الجدول التفصيلي لكل أمسية قبيل موعدها، لذلك لم تصدر بعد مواعيد فتح البوابات وترتيب الأشواط لمعظم الموسم. الخطوة العملية لمن يخطط: ثبت مواعيد الكؤوس الكبرى أعلاه في تقويمك الآن، ثم تابع الصفحة مع اقتراب الأمسية التي اخترتها لمعرفة تفاصيل تلك العطلة.

هل يمكنني حضور يوم سباق عادي بدلا من أيام الكؤوس؟

نعم، بل قد يكون ذلك المدخل الأفضل. فمع سباقات كل جمعة وسبت من أكتوبر إلى أبريل، تكون معظم الأيام أمسيات اعتيادية من دون زحام أيام الكؤوس، وتحصل على المضمار نفسه ومستوى السباق نفسه بتجربة أيسر بكثير. خمسون يوم سباق تعني فرصا كثيرة لاختيار يومك المثالي.

كيف أحجز تذاكر موسم سباقات الرياض؟

كل شيء يمر عبر صفحة واحدة: صفحة موسم سباقات الرياض في webook.com. تنشر تذاكر أيام السباق لموسم 2026-2027 هناك مع فتح الحجز. ولم يعلن نادي سباقات الخيل أسعار التذاكر للموسم الجديد بعد، وعند فتح الحجز لأي أمسية تظهر أسعارها على الصفحة أولا.

ولبقية فعاليات المدينة في أي عطلة سباق، من حفلات ومطاعم وأيام عائلية، تصفح فعاليات الرياض. وإن كانت السباقات مدخلك إلى الرياضة السعودية، فإن دليل أبرز الفعاليات الرياضية في السعودية يغطي ما تستضيفه المملكة على مدار العام.

قادم إلى الرياض من خارج السعودية؟

رحلة كأس السعودية زيارة طبيعية من يومين، وكل التفاصيل العملية في مكان واحد. تبدأ رحلات الطيران من أداة البحث عن الرحلات في webook.com، ولعطلة فبراير يستحسن الوصول مساء الخميس حتى لا تضيع أمسية الجمعة في إرهاق السفر.

items.title: Powerhouse Parramatta, Sydney
items.note: Sydney's biggest cultural build since the Opera House, opening 7 Nov with mostly free exhibitions.
items.read: The NSW Government announced that Powerhouse Parramatta, Western Sydney's first state cultural institution, would open to the public on Saturday 7 November 2026 on the banks of the Parramatta River. The $915 million project is described as the most significant cultural infrastructure project since the Sydney Opera House, and entry to the museum and most exhibitions is free. The five opening exhibitions show more than 3,000 objects, including Task Eternal with the historic Qantas Avro 504k aircraft, and The Mall, which features Steve Jobs' Levi's 501 jeans and a ballet of warehouse robots by Japanese artist yang02.
facts: free to the museum and most exhibitions

article.html:
Located on the banks of the Parramatta River, the museum will be a major new landmark for Australia and a global cultural destination for Western Sydney.

Its opening marks the most significant cultural infrastructure project since the Sydney Opera House. The Powerhouse Parramatta is $915 million project, including $75 million philanthropic contribution, and the delivery of the new Castle Hill collection storage facility.

A celebration of applied arts and sciences, most of its exhibitions will be free. The first five exhibitions will showcase more than 3000 objects, with more than 1600 from the Powerhouse’s own collection, with others sourced from collections around the world.

The first exhibition, Task Eternal, will include the historic Qantas Avro 504k aircraft and explore the intersection of design, innovation and technology and trace humanity’s quest to human ambition to defy gravity, take flight and journey into the sky. The second major exhibition, The Mall, has today been announced as the next opening exhibition, one of five groundbreaking exhibitions which will premiere at the opening.

The exhibition examines the history, evolution and cultural significance of the shopping mall, one of the most influential and ubiquitous forms of architecture in modern life.

Western Sydney played a foundational role in the development of global urban shopping centres with Blacktown the location of the very first large-scale, transport-integrated Westfield shopping centre, opened in 1959.

From Blacktown and later Parramatta, Westfield grew to export the urban shopping malls concept to stores across Australia, the United States, United Kingdom, New Zealand and Italy.

Unfolding across two storeys, the exhibition explores Australian and global innovation across architecture, design, technology, engineering and fashion with over 560 objects from the Powerhouse Collection, presented alongside more than 280 loans, ephemera and personal stories collected from the local community.

Highlights include:

  • Victor Gruen’s archive. The archive of Austrian-American architect and urban planner and a mastermind of modern American mall design, presented for the first time.
  • Rare archives from Australian brands including Le Specs, Hot Tuna, Mambo, Globe, Crumpler, Above the Clouds and Song for the Mute.
  • The art of visual merchandising: a reimagining of a 19th-century arcade, featuring a series of window displays developed in collaboration with leading Australian brands Breville, David Jones, Oroton, R.M. Williams and Sportsgirl
  • The signature Levi’s 501 jeans worn by Apple co-founder Steve Jobs and the Predator Boot prototypes, conceived by former Liverpool player, Australian Craig Johnston and worn by David Beckham.
  • An Australian premiere of acclaimed South Korean artist Ayoung Kim an animated film, co-commissioned with M+ in Hong Kong
  • The iconic Raindrop Fountain from Southwest Sydney’s Roselands which has been reimagined and created by industrial design studio Vert.
  • Japanese artist yang02 presents an autonomous ballet of warehouse robots, developed with KNAPP.

Deputy Premier and Minister for Western Sydney, Prue Car said:

“From the Powerhouse Parramatta and Metro West to the new Western Sydney Airport, Western Sydney represents an opportunity for the state’s visitor economy.

“Powerhouse Parramatta will give our region’s young people more and better access to our engineering and innovation history, inspiring Western Sydney’s next generation of scientists, designers, and engineers.”

Minister for the Arts, John Graham said:

“When it opens this November, Powerhouse Parramatta will transform Parramatta, linking the centre with the riverfront.

“Visitors to the Museum will have great cost of living options as entry to the Museum and most exhibitions will be free.

“It will bring audiences from across Sydney, NSW, Australia and the world to explore its bold exhibitions and reshape what audiences think of a museum experience.”

Minister for Lands and Property Steve Kamper said:

“The Minns Labor Government is delivering a world-class cultural institution in the heart of Western Sydney that will transform the Parramatta River waterfront and become a crown jewel for the region.

“Powerhouse Parramatta will give Western Sydney a cultural institution on a scale it deserves and help cement Parramatta as a major new cultural and tourism destination that will draw visitors from across Australia and around the world, while creating jobs and supporting local businesses across Western Sydney.”

Parliamentary Secretary for the Arts and Member for Granville, Julia Finn said:

“The opening of the Powerhouse Parramatta will be a proud moment for Western Sydney. It’s been made for and by Western Sydney creatives, workers, and local businesses.

“Western Sydney has a long history of leading the world with our creativity and innovation, which have profoundly impacted the way we live.

Member for Parramatta, Donna Davis said:

“For years and years Parra Mall was the food court of choice for workers and locals alike and one of the few places to grab a quick lunch. While Parra Mall has made way for the Metro I look forward to the Powerhouse Parramatta exhibition taking me back to the aromas and lunchtime shopping at the mall shopping at the mall in the 90s.

“We know visitors from across the region are in high anticipation to cross the threshold of Powerhouse Parramatta. And those coming from interstate or overseas will soon head straight from the new airport to the Museum to explore the best innovations and creativity from around our city, state and the globe.”

Powerhouse CEO, Lisa Havilah said:

“Powerhouse Parramatta is a museum built for the future, where local knowledge meets global perspectives. We are thrilled to be opening our doors this November with five world-class exhibitions and a program that is as bold and diverse as the communities it serves.”

items.read: Graff's festive campaign “I Wish,” unveiled on 5 November, stars BTS's Jung Kook, the brand's global ambassador, in an all-white jacket and turtleneck layered with pieces from the Lawrence Graff Signature collection, Graff's first unisex jewelry line. In the hero film he says “Graff, I wish for you” and opens a jewelry box to reveal a seven-carat oval diamond ring flanked by heart-shaped shoulder stones. The collection comes in yellow, white and rose gold, with pavé diamond options, and a behind-the-scenes video was released alongside the campaign.

items.title: Google Pixel Tag
items.note: Google's $30 AirTag rival for Android went on sale this week, with a surprise NFC addition.
items.read: TechCrunch reports that the Google Pixel Tag went on sale on 10 November for $29.99, letting Android users find keys, wallets or bags through the Find Hub app with Bluetooth and ultra-wideband precision finding. It is slimmer and more oval than Apple's AirTag, has a physical button and a speaker that reaches about 80 decibels, and relies on a network of over a billion Android devices to locate items that are far away. It runs on a replaceable CR2032 battery rated for up to a year, is IP67 water and dust resistant, and comes in silver and pale green, singly or in a four-pack for $99.99.
facts: Android 9 or newer, via Find Hub
replaceable CR2032, up to one year

article.html:
Google’s answer to Apple’s AirTag, the Google Pixel Tag, goes on sale starting Tuesday, allowing Android users to track items like their keys, wallet, or bag using their smartphone’s built-in Find Hub.

First announced in August, the $29.99 device takes cues from the AirTag and other lost-item finders by offering connectivity via Bluetooth and ultra-wideband for precision finding. This lets Android device owners, including Pixel Watch wearers, locate their missing items using a combination of visual distance and directional guidance.

Plus, the tag has a built-in speaker to play a chime that helps you locate your item if nearby. (Or, if you’ve lost your phone, you can press the button on the Pixel Tag twice to ring it, too.) You can choose between three different levels of loudness in the settings within the Find Hub, with the maximum volume around 80 decibels.

Though the Pixel Tag serves the same purpose as an AirTag, Google has opted for a different design. Instead of a small, round device, like Apple’s, the Pixel Tag is slimmer and more elongated.

Spec-by-spec, the Pixel Tag is 1.1-inches wide, compared to the AirTag’s 1.26 inches. As the Pixel Tag is oval-shaped, it’s 1.8-inches high from top to bottom. Thickness-wise, the Pixel Tag clocks in at a depth of 0.2 inches, compared with the AirTag’s 0.31 inches (which Apple calls its height). The slimness of the device might make it more appealing for some, particularly if they’re adding the tag to a small item, like a keychain.

The device weighs just 0.4 oz, with the battery included.

Unlike Apple, Google opted for a physical button you can press on the tag, which makes it more obvious how it’s meant to work.

Google didn’t originally say that the Pixel Tag included NFC when it announced the device in August. NFC is used by Apple’s AirTag to aid people who find lost items, as they can tap the side of the tag to launch a webpage that displays the owner’s contact information. Google uses the tap gesture to instead connect the user to the device’s settings.

Meanwhile, for lost items that are not nearby, the Pixel Tag relies on Google’s crowdsourced network of over a billion Android devices globally. The network, similar to competitive offerings from Apple and Tile, taps into the connectivity provided by other Android devices, which can identify and share the location of the lost item back to its owner. This location information is displayed on a map inside the Find Hub app.

While the person who found the item can’t tap it, as with NFC-enabled devices, Pixel Tags that are put into “Lost” mode will be able to share the owner’s email, number, and a short message so the person who finds the tag can contact you. When the tag comes back into range of the user’s phone, the item is automatically marked as found.

The Pixel Tag’s location can also be shared with up to 10 people in the Find Hub app, which could be useful for shared items like the family car keys, which multiple people might rely on.

Like AirTag, the Pixel Tag is powered by a user-replaceable coin cell battery (the CR2032), which makes the device reusable for the long term. (Google claims the device has up to one year of battery life to start.)

Meanwhile, the device itself is made from stainless steel and features IP67 water and dust resistance (maximum depth of 1 meter up to 30 minutes). It pairs with devices running Android 9 or newer via Fast Pair technology.

The Pixel Tag comes in two shades: silver and a pale green, and can be bought individually or in a four-pack for $99.99.

Alongside the launch, the company Bellroy is debuting its own keychain cases in a variety of colors and styles, which will also be sold on the Google Store.

Post updated after publication to note that the Pixel Tag now supports NFC, which was a surprise addition not mentioned at the time of its announcement.

items.title: Beni, the jumping robot cameraman
items.note: The follow-you camera robot that went viral with tech YouTubers is now on sale for $799.
items.read: PetaPixel reports that Mondo Robotics' Beni, a rolling robot that follows you and films, went on sale on 10 November after raising over $5 million on Kickstarter and shipping more than 5,000 units to backers in October. It tracks its owner, avoids obstacles, rights itself after a fall and can jump up to 10 inches, which lets it climb stairs; the company says it reaches 17.9 mph. It records 4K at 60fps, 1080p at 120fps or vertical 3K for TikTok and Instagram, with 32GB of storage plus microSD. The Standard kit is $799, and the Explore combo, with three batteries and off-road wheels, is $959.

items.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway
items.note: Netflix's new No. 1 English series, with 12.9M views in its debut week.
items.read: ComingSoon reports that the three-part true-crime docuseries Taken: Natalee Holloway debuted at No. 1 on Netflix's English TV chart for the week of 2 to 8 November 2026, with 12.9 million views. It revisits the May 2005 disappearance of 18-year-old Natalee Holloway during a graduation trip to Aruba, a case that stayed unresolved for years until a major development in 2023. The One About Matthew Perry came second with 4.4 million views, followed by season 3 of Nobody Wants This with 4 million.

items.title: The 10-for-9 sub board and the sarcastic clap
items.note: A football skit where the subbed-off player gives the slowest, most sarcastic applause ever. Over 7M views on one repost alone.
items.read: This one-minute clip, shared by @BenYousef_E with the caption “Who is this guy,” is a staged football comedy skit, not a real match. X's trend summary describes a referee holding up a substitution board with 10 in red and 9 in green while a player in a red shirt gives over-the-top sarcastic applause on his way off, and credits the skit to creator Muhammad Shaif. Troll Football reposted the same video as “My new favourite player” and drew another 3.6 million views. Fans keep calling it the funniest football clip they've seen in ages.

items.title: Little cousins instead of saying hello
items.note: An AI GIF of a baby hippo and an alligator waddling upright, now everyone's reaction for chaotic kids.
items.read: User acce (@accekid) posted a short GIF captioned “What my little cousins do when they see me instead of just saying hello.” According to X's trend summary, the AI-generated clip shows a baby hippo and an alligator walking stiffly on their hind legs down a city street, looking cute but vaguely threatening. People have since reused it for kids demanding snacks, grabbing phones back or swarming relatives at family gatherings, and some are turning it into stickers. It has become one of the most-shared reaction GIFs of the week.

items.title: “I learned to make GIF stickers, I'm going to be unbearable”
items.note: A Spanish post about a TikTok sticker tutorial hit 40M views, and now everyone is pasting GIFs as stickers.
items.read: User @miensha00 posted in Spanish, in all caps, that they had learned to make stickers out of GIFs thanks to a TikTok tutorial and were going to be insufferable, with a GIF attached. The post took off, and a follow-up quote post from @kekatothepink explained that all you have to do is copy a GIF and paste it, adding a 12-second how-to video. That explainer alone pulled about 19.5 million views and nearly 199,000 likes. The combination is a big part of why reaction GIFs like the hippo and alligator are spreading as stickers this week.

items.title: Two rats square up in an alley
items.note: Two rats rear up on their hind legs mid-standoff, and it's the new “don't test me” reaction.
items.read: RIO (@seeka_brian) posted an 11-second clip captioned simply “Wtf” with a laughing emoji. X's trend summary describes two rats standing upright on their hind legs among trash in a grimy alley, mouths open as if about to fight, with the bigger one glaring. Nigerian users started captioning it with everyday standoffs, and it is spreading as a GIF for bold confrontations. Some replies joke that the rats think they're the hippo and alligator.

items.title: The monkey chef who flinches at the steam
items.note: A capuchin shields its face from a smoking wok with a plate, then stirs like a pro.
items.read: User dani (@chukwunonyerem_) posted the GIF with the caption “what is this GIF???” According to X's trend summary, it shows a white-faced capuchin monkey in a rustic kitchen holding up a blue plate to block the steam from a hot wok, then grabbing a ladle and stirring dramatically. Another account, @Trissy001, followed up with the full 21-second video for anyone who wanted it. People are using it as a reaction for shock and disbelief, and one repost called it the funniest GIF they'd ever seen.

items.title: The giant orange cat vs. the yellow truck
items.note: An absurd AI GIF of a huge cat stretching against a truck on a village road has Nigerian X in tears.
items.read: MALEEK 1.0 (@Maleekoyibo) posted the GIF with the caption “This is the funniest thing I have seen today.” X's trend summary describes an oversized orange cat with white paws awkwardly pushing or stretching against a yellow truck on a dusty village road, tail flopping, while people walk past. It is part of a wave of AI-generated cat clips, and replies keep asking who is making all these GIFs. A near-identical share by @Piazon_75 drew a similar audience.

items.title: AI Seinfeld: George and the “Chinese models”
items.note: An AI Seinfeld skit riffs on the Nvidia CEO spy-affair story, the week's biggest meme topic.
items.read: Creator Christian Moss (@MandelDuck) posted a roughly one-minute AI-generated Seinfeld skit captioned “George also enjoys the ‘chinese’ models.” X's trend summary says it puts George Costanza in a plot where a woman posing as a Chinese spy presses him for secret AI models, with Jerry and George reacting from their couch. It riffs on reports about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair and alleged intelligence links, which Know Your Meme says turned into a flood of “honeypot” memes this week. Fans call it AI Seinfeld perfection, while others say the writing doesn't match the show.

items.title: The oven clock says 2:47
items.note: A painfully relatable ADHD time-blindness meme: you have plenty of time, until you don't.
items.read: UltraLittleBirdie (@FluffWingBirdie) shared a roughly one-minute video captioned “So true.” X's trend summary says it uses a kitchen clock stuck at 2:47 to show how people with ADHD glance at the time, decide they have plenty left, then end up rushing as minutes slip away. Replies mixed laughs and relief with personal stories and tips, like stacking calendar alarms or working backward from deadlines.

items.title: Riyadh's mood after the rain
items.note: #امطار_الرياض_الان and #صباح_الاجواء_الحلوه top Saudi trends as rain soaks the capital and nearby schools go remote.
items.read: Rain over Riyadh pushed #امطار_الرياض_الان (Riyadh rain now), #مطر_الليل (night rain) and #صباح_الاجواء_الحلوه (good-weather morning) to the top of X's Saudi trends this morning. This small post from @AFXX990 sums up the vibe with the caption “Riyadh people's mood after the rain” and a laughing emoji, plus attached media. The weather also fed a flurry of school-suspension speculation: a widely viewed post from the account @SahabatAlRiyadh listed governorates such as Al-Majma'ah, Shaqra, Al-Zulfi and Afif switching to remote learning today, and said Riyadh city was already studying remotely. It is a fun local snapshot, not an official announcement.

items.title: “Mister Beast, calm down”
items.note: AI edits make the ever-cheerful MrBeast scream at contestants over tiny mistakes, like dropped blueberries.
items.read: Know Your Meme added an entry on 9 November for MrBeast Chill Out or Crashout edits, AI-assisted clips that make MrBeast appear to explode at people over small mistakes. The earliest known example, from TikToker @ikowels on 28 October, shows him screaming after a contestant drops a container of blueberries, captioned “Mister beast calm down.” Later versions have him yelling at school kids, at a child who fails a challenge, and at someone who admits they don't watch his videos. The joke works because the fake meltdowns are the opposite of his real upbeat persona.
facts: TikTok, then Instagram Reels and X
@texaspja, over 7.8 million views in a week

article.html:

About

MrBeast Chill Out or MrBeast Crashout is a series of AI-assisted memes in which MrBeast clips are edited to make it appear as if MrBeast is crashing out and yelling at someone in a video for making a mistake. The trend was popularized in early November 2026 on TikTok and spread to Instagram Reels and X / Twitter that month as it grew online.

Origin

On October 28th, 2026, TikToker[1] @ikowels posted an edit of a MrBeast clip in which he starts aggressively screaming after a contestant in one of his challenge videos drops a container of blueberries. The video is captioned, "Mister beast calm down," and gained over 311,000 views in about two weeks. This is one of the earliest known examples of the meme.


Spread

The MrBeast memes continued to spread on TikTok in late October and early November 2026.

On October 30th, 2026, TikToker[2] @blorhes posted a version of the meme where MrBeast crashes out on a group of school children, garnering over 3.1 million views in a week.

On November 1st, TikToker[3] @texaspja posted a version of the meme where MrBeast yells at a child for failing at one of his challenge videos, garnering over 7.8 million views in a week. On November 3rd, X[4] user @All_ofthe_Stars reposted the video, gaining over 15,000 likes in six days.

On November 5th, 2026, TikToker[5] @lightning_damnis posted a version of the meme in which MrBeast crashes out on someone who doesn't watch his videos, gaining over 2.1 million views in four days. That day, X[6] user @milkhover reposted one of the creator's other videos following the meme format, which gained over 9,400 likes in four days.

article.html:
New in version 2.25.0

* Bug fixes and performance improvements.
* See link to full changelog in app description.

Feeder is an open source feed reader (RSS/Atom/JSONFeed) for Android created in 2014.

With Feeder you can read the latest news and posts from your favorite sites.

Feeder does NOT sync with usual remote backends so no account registration of any kind is necessary.

Feeder is free to use and runs locally on your device. Your data is 100% private.

Features


  • Parses HTML and displays it in a native TextView

  • Offline reading

  • Background synchronization

  • Notifications

  • OPML Import/Export

  • Handy access to enclosure links

  • Material design
